description: Issue #196, profile-contract.md §10.2: an unknown key inside `dispatch_defaults` is refused, not skipped. `schedule` is the realistic one — release-notes.md records it as deliberately LEFT OUT of #180 (it is a property of the run, not of the repository) — so a profile written for a runner that adopted it must fail loudly on this one rather than run with half its declaration honored. Refused at profile load, before an issue is read. The code is `load_error` / exit 6, not the dispatch runner's `plan_invalid` / exit 3: the fact here is about the PROFILE file, and every other malformed profile field exits the same way, so the message sends the reader to the file they can fix.
